useful_interfaces.finding: witness/1 has source/manifest hashes, geometry, PLAN/OWNERS, exact dispatch/call order and allowlisted provider recipe chains. witness-expected/1 holds computed artifact/profile/count/moment/kappa comparison values and binds raw WITNESS bytes.

pin(key,got) compares EXPECTED lookup then returns got; discovery returns got without lookup. Verifier.pinned has the same direction. The inspected admission call sites pass newly read/computed outputs, not expected-value constructors.

cold_kernel,multicut,greedy_kernels,promote,joint_prefix,frozen558_scalar_audits select fixed constructor/audit code paths. Input recipe SHA is checked before use; input/output decompressed-word digests and omission counts are compared after construction.

Static stage verifies source manifests and selected files, optional full_tree, PLAN/OWNERS and recipe pins. Future Lean literal extraction should consume these exact input records and emitted rows, retaining source indices; expected statistics are comparison targets only.

Only seconds excluded from sorted semantic digest; raw receipt/owner/invoice bindings are recomputed coherently. Timing-only acceptance and substantive-phase rejection are separate controls, preserving prior PR582 rule.

Complex native/conservative endpoints come from M.certify and are independently rechecked. Bit lower is read from exact Git-blob-pinned PR543-EXPECTED input then rechecked at c and c+1e-24; that input is distinct from the new comparison-only EXPECTED document.

limits: No new Lean theorem or selected f19 label/scalar/operator supplier is closed by this Python tooling.
Example uses changed PR582 ck/atm3/jp8 providers, even though geometry112/9/504/8 resembles f19. Exact row/recipe/owner identity must be established before reusing any receipt.
spec.problems checks required keys and dispatch/step shape, not a fully strict untrusted-input type/path/duplicate-key validator. Keep our strict bounded decoder at extraction.

Discovery skips phase-timing controls and records accepted spec-only negative controls; strict verify from scratch is still required. Development reuse-baseline/reuse-local flags must be disclosed and do not equal fresh replay.

No EXPECTED.json, TEST-RESULTS.json or test logs are among the14 changed files. Eight passing tests are upstream-reported; inspected test code defines four fixture outcomes plus four mutations. No tests run here.
Accounting remains fixed73-column/inherited envelope; geometry-driven construction is not an arbitrary-model theorem.
